critical_code_review_comments: PricingCalculator.js continues to grow; after Apparel it is likely >3400 lines. Strongly recommend splitting each category card into its own component (e.g., ApparelCard.js, VehicleGraphicsCard.js) for maintainability.
Conditional rendering of ap-two-tone and ap-leather-patch only for hat products is correct per spec (hats-only) — testids appear dynamically after hat_premium selection.
Backend baseline_source labeling ('shop_table:<method>' vs 'cost_plus:<method>') is clean and directly testable. Keep this convention across future method additions.

Backend breakdown uses flat keys like plus_size_cost / specialty_cost / two_tone_cost / patch_cost / bag_fold_cost / custom_name_number_cost — consistent naming. Frontend Pricing Breakdown display keys should match.
Consider adding unit tests for edge case: qty=0 or negative qty (currently untested).
